item.title: MPESB Police Constable Bharti 2026
item.description: The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) is expected to release the MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Notification in October/November 2026, as per the official MPESB Exam Calendar. The recruitment drive will be conducted to fill 7,500 Police Constable vacancies across various units of the Madhya Pradesh Police Department. The detailed notification will include information about the application schedule, educational qualification, age limit, category-wise vacancies, physical standards, selection process, exam pattern, syllabus, and other important instructions. Candidates preparing for the MP Police Constable Exam 2026 are advised to regularly check the official updates and keep their required documents ready for the online application process.

item.title: MP SI Subedar Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 507 Posts, Check Eligibility & Exam Date
item.description: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has invited online applications for 507 posts of Subedar and Sub Inspector (DEF, SAF, and Technical Branches) under the MP Police Department.
